note: Records that are NOT in National_Health_Assurance_Framework_v2.0.0_FINAL.docx, appended in this order after the records the DOCX yields. The merit health-talent immigration KPP/TPP were added by hand in 2026-08; KPP-E6, disability accommodation compliance, was added on 2026-10-13 for a plan requirement the dictionary gave no metric (owner, 2026-10-12). research/post_framework_additions.md lists every one. They are carried here so src/lib/quality-data.ts regenerates rather than being maintained by hand. Sourcing or quarantining the immigration records is R115.

additions.merit-immigration: the merit health-talent immigration parameters, which the plan adopted later and has not yet put through control
additions.disability-accommodation: a disability accommodation metric defined for a plan requirement the dictionary gave no metric that measures it

records.name: Health workforce sufficiency ratio
records.calculation: filled safe-FTE / required safe-FTE across role-region cells, with no cell below its staffing floor
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Shortage-area staffing sufficiency
records.target: >=95% of designated HPSA and MUA positions filled
records.calculation: filled safe-FTE in designated shortage areas / required safe-FTE in those areas
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.value: >=95% of designated HPSA and MUA positions filled
rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Merit immigration shortage-role fill rate
records.calculation: health-talent admissions placed into designated shortage occupations or regions / total health-talent admissions
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Internationally recruited clinician retention

records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Role-region vacancy rate ceiling

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Health-talent petition processing time

records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.name: Disability accommodation compliance
records.calculation: lowest of three rates: care sites meeting the federal accessible medical diagnostic equipment standard / sites audited; recorded accommodation requests (auxiliary aids and services, reasonable modifications) delivered by the visit / requests recorded; patients with a recorded disability reporting the accommodation they needed / those surveyed
records.datasets: site accessibility audits; coverage/care records with accommodation needs and requests; patient experience survey with approved disability strata
records.status: Plan-defined metric carrying the plan's disability accommodation requirement; no national baseline exists, see Sources and methodology

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.
